ConnectionStrings.//Sentinel: Authenticates as postgres and immediately drops into the sentinel_app role, which switches superuser off — so the session has exactly the privileges sentinel_app will have. Connecting as sentinel_app directly is refused until pg_hba.conf on 192.168.2.151 gains a line for it; see deploy/README.md. Change Username to sentinel_app and remove Options once it does.

Secrets.//Key: Base64 of 32 bytes, from a secret store. Must be the same value the API host holds — they encrypt and decrypt the same stored credentials.

Safety.//NeverBlockAddresses: Set before enabling any blocking rule. The estate's own egress ranges belong here: a brute-force rule behind NAT identifies the address every employee shares.
